title: The measure inspector stops carrying a document-wide Export section
goal: Selecting a measurement shows an Export section with Copy Image and Export PNG in the layer inspector, but those two actions export the whole document, not the selected measurement, so they read as random. Move them out of the per-layer inspector: the menu bar and toolbar already own them, and what belongs beside a selected measurement is the measurement-specific copy (its one spec line).
notes: The user reacted to this on 2026-09-02 in Photonz Dev, release Next: why have a random export section in the workspace. Source: LayersPanel.swift exportSection, shown from the measure inspector when Experiments.shared.measurePanelEnabled. It was added per the redline mock (docs/design/next-measure.md section 7, Export: the redline sheet) which staged Copy image / Export PNG in the Properties panel; the app-wide actions already exist (copyCompositeToClipboard, exportComposite). Copy Measurement (copyMeasurement(id:)) now exists from the spec-export task and is the natural replacement. Update next-measure.md section 7 shipped shape when the section moves.
acceptance: Selecting a measure layer no longer shows an Export section with Copy Image and Export PNG
Copy Image and Export PNG remain reachable from the File and Edit menus and their shortcuts, unchanged
If a per-measurement action stays in the inspector it is Copy Measurement, the one spec line for that measurement, and it says so
Audit written under queue/audits/ with a screenshot of the inspector for a selected measurement

log.note: Pre-build review: confirmed the mismatch in code. LayersPanel exportSection called copyCompositeToClipboard and exportComposite(.png, 1), both whole-document, rendered under a single selected measurement. Also checked what else owns them: not the toolbar (the task assumed one), only File > Copy Image (shift-cmd-C) and File > Export... (shift-cmd-E). The export dialog opens on PNG at 1x, so shift-cmd-E then Return is exactly the removed button; nothing is lost by removing it.

Shortest version that keeps the value: drop the section, keep ONE measurement-specific action. Copy Measurement (copyMeasurement(id:)) already exists from the spec-export task and is what a redliner wants beside a selected measurement. Added the exact spec line it will copy under the button (MeasureSpecList.specLine, read live from the document), so the button needs no explaining and a rename or unit change updates it in place.
Shipped: LayersPanel.swift exportSection -> copySection, still behind next-measure-panel. swift build clean, Scripts/test.sh green (1401 tests).

Verified in the real app via the playtest harness (probe bundle): placed a size measurement, selected it, snapshotted the window. Export section gone; Copy Measurement plus '- Width: 124 px (size)' present. Screenshot saved as queue/audits/2026-09-02-measure-inspector-copy-1.png. Probe quit.
docs/design/next-measure.md section 7 updated: the mock's Export section is recorded as shipped then removed, with why, and the shipped shape now names copySection.
